service.name: Live music for an engagement party
service.serviceType: A jazz duo, a Spanish guitarist, a singer with a guitar or a party band for engagement parties and the party after a proposal
service.description: Live music for an engagement party across Denver and the Front Range: a jazz duo playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA under the dinner with both families, a Spanish guitarist under a long table, a singer with a guitar who learns the couple's song for the night, and a trio or quartet for the engagement party that dances, at home, on a patio or in a private dining space, with the same duo available for the wedding's cocktail hour on one contract and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can we hire a band for an engagement party?
faqs.a: Yes. An engagement party is usually a dinner or a cocktail party for forty, so the jazz duo is the size to price first: upright bass and guitar playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table. A singer with a guitar plays the party where the couple's song has to be sung, a Spanish guitarist plays a long dinner, and a trio or a quartet plays the engagement party the friends throw. It's one contract with one personal contact and an announcement microphone for the toasts.

faqs.q: What are engagement party entertainment ideas?
faqs.a: The couple's song played once in front of both families, learned for the night; a preview of the wedding's musicians, because the duo at the engagement party can be the duo at the cocktail hour; a Spanish guitarist under dinner; a singer with a guitar taking both families' requests; a trio for the friends' version of the party; and live band karaoke for the wedding party, months early.

faqs.q: Can the same musicians play the engagement party and the wedding?
faqs.a: Yes, on one contract. The duo the families hear at the engagement party plays the cocktail hour on the wedding day, and the singer who learns the couple's song for the engagement party already has it for the first dance, because the first learned song is included in every booking. Tell us both dates with the enquiry.

faqs.q: Can you do the party right after the proposal?
faqs.a: Yes. The friends set up the house while the question is being asked somewhere else, and the couple walks in to everyone they know with their song already playing, which is the same booking as a proposal with a musician: set up early, playing at conversation volume, with the song on a cue. The proposals and surprise songs page covers how the cue works, and one booking can cover the question and the party.

faqs.q: What does live music for an engagement party cost?
faqs.a: The pricing page covers what live music costs in this market and the cost guide has the Colorado figures, wedding cocktail hours included. An engagement party and the cocktail hour it leads to are quoted together when you send both dates, so tell us the place and the couple's song and we'll come back with a configuration and a price for each night.

faqs.q: Can the band play on a patio at an engagement party?
faqs.a: Yes, under cover, with a wall socket through the nearest window. A singer with a guitar takes 6 by 4 feet on one circuit, a duo 8 by 6 on one and a trio 12 by 8 on one, and once the sun goes down the loud part of a patio party moves indoors or to the DJ. The backyard party page sets out the power, the cover and the after-dark rule for a yard.
